name: fenix-volei
description: Base técnica do sistema web Fênix Vôlei.

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run prisma:validate && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names web,api --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.test: node --test scripts/startup.spec.cjs apps/api/test/test-database.spec.cjs && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:seed: npm run build --workspace=@fenix/api && dotenv -e .env -- node apps/api/dist/cli/seed.js
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:demo: npm run build --workspace=@fenix/api && dotenv -e .env -- node apps/api/dist/cli/demo.js
scripts.db:clean-test-data: npm run build --workspace=@fenix/api && dotenv -e .env -- node apps/api/dist/cli/clean-test-data.js
scripts.db:fees-ended-plans: npm run build --workspace=@fenix/api && dotenv -e .env -- node apps/api/dist/cli/fees-ended-plans.js
scripts.mfa:reset: npm run build --workspace=@fenix/api && dotenv -e .env -- node apps/api/dist/cli/mfa-reset.js
scripts.storage:migrate: npm run build --workspace=@fenix/api && dotenv -e .env -- node apps/api/dist/cli/storage-migrate.js
scripts.e2e: npm run build --workspace=@fenix/api && node e2e/prepare.cjs && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
